Kuvitus: tyhjä koulun sali talviaamuna v: Illustration: an empty school hall on a winter morning, ready for a six-hour exam. The hall has three rows of desks with laptops, paper and pens, and chairs in front of them. There is a large clock on the wall, and through the window snowy spruces and a low sun can be seen. On the desk in the foreground there is a water bottle and a squared notebook with a graph drawn in pencil. There are no people and no text in the picture.
Kaavio mittakaavassa: kuuden tunnin eli: Scale diagram: the time plan of six hours, or 360 minutes, as a single bar. Reading and choosing 15 min, Part I 50 min, Part II 160 min, that is four problems of about 40 min each, Part III 110 min, that is two problems of about 55 min each, and checking 25 min. Above the bar are hour marks 0–6 h.
Voimakuvio: työkalulaatikko suorakulmion: Free-body diagram: a toolbox as a rectangle on the horizontal bed of a trailer, while the trailer brakes and moves to the right. The weight G points from the centre of the box straight down, the normal force N from the bottom surface straight up and is as long as the weight, and the static friction F μ0 points from the lower left corner of the bottom surface to the left, that is backwards. Above the box a blue velocity arrow v points to the right and an orange acceleration arrow a to the left.
Kuvaaja: ilmanvastus F v millinewtoneina: Graph: air resistance F v in millinewtons as a function of the square of the constant speed v². Six measured points between 1.1–6.5 m²/s² and 12–71 mN lie on a line through the origin. The point (6.00 m²/s²; 64.2 mN) has been read from the line with dashed lines. The slope is about 10.7 mN·s²/m², that is 0.0107 kg/m.
Kuvaaja: kallion lämpötila T celsiusaste: Graph: the temperature T of the rock in degrees Celsius as a function of the depth z in kilometres. Six measured points at depths of 0.5–3.0 km rise in a straight line from 15 degrees to 58 degrees. The fitted line starts on the vertical axis at about 6.7 degrees and is solid over the measured range and dashed from a depth of 3 km to a depth of 6 km, where it is at about 109 degrees. The points (0 km; 6.7 °C) and (3.0 km; 58.0 °C) read from the line are circled.
Kuvaaja: värähdysjakson neliö T² neliöse: Graph: the square of the period T² in seconds squared as a function of the mass m in kilograms. Six measured points with masses of 0.100–0.600 kg rise in a straight line. The fitted line crosses the vertical axis slightly above the origin, at about 0.032 s². The points (0 kg; 0.032 s²) and (0.600 kg; 0.979 s²) read from the line are circled. The slope is about 1.58 s²/kg.
